ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: The College Experience. Second Half-Session Class. 3 credit hours. (a 2 credit hour option is also offered, crn 33898; enroll for only 1 of these two sections.) First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen in the Unit One Living-Learning Community through October 9, 2006, or by permission of instructor. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. Students who enroll in more than one Discovery course may be dropped from the additional Discovery Courses. For course descriptions, see the Discovery Program booklet. For more information, go to https://netfiles.uiuc.edu/hschein/www/
